references.shows: Maker reference for the chosen instrument form and proportions.
Second view or guide for checking the fit of the tubing and the controls.

silhouette: Wide upright bell above a deep asymmetric wrap with a heavy lower bow.
features: Wide bell rim and strongly expanding bell stack
Large bottom bow linking the bell and valve side
Four top-action pistons above the smaller slides
Leadpipe curving down from the opposite upper side
iconFeatures: Wide bell rim and strongly expanding bell stack
Large bottom bow linking the bell and valve side
avoid: Overlapping tubes that hide the principal bends
Detached or offset mouthpiece and bell
notes: Shows the modern form in the reference. The muted linework keeps the major tube bends distinct.

geometry.view: Front three-quarter of upright four-piston form
geometry.proportions: Broad bell and deep, wide bottom bow dominate the asymmetric body.
geometry.partLayout: Follow the bell throat into the outer wrap. A thinner leadpipe curves from the opposite side into four top pistons and smaller internal slides.

documentedDimensions.value: 443 mm bell diameter with an 18.5–19.5 mm bore. These are physical cross-sections, not widths in an oblique drawing.
